column1: # p374 — THE ADDRESS CENSUS COUNTS ONE CHANNEL OF TWO, AND THE OTHER WAS BUILT SEVEN PASSES AGO.
# Measured 2026-10-22, over the nine SHELF_FILES of the tree this pass commits.
# 🔴 HOW IT WAS FOUND, and it was an accident.  p374 wrote `benjaminvialle/Markus` onto three live
# shelves as a bare backticked slug, to record that it is a DISTINCT FORK of MarkUsProject/Markus
# and must not be shelved as a casing of it.  The census delta came back +2, not +3.  Probing for
# the missing one: the harvester sees it NEITHER as an address NOR as a reject.  It is invisible.
# 🔴 THE CAUSE, first-hand.  p351's census imports p348's harvester -- the file says so:
# "the harvester is p348's, not rewritten".  p348's pattern is:
#       SLUG = re.compile(r"github\.com/([A-Za-z0-9_.-]+/[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+)")
# It requires the literal `github.com/` prefix.  A backticked `owner/repo` with no URL matches
# NOTHING, so it never enters the denominator and never enters the reject list.
# 🔴 AND THE PART THAT MAKES THIS THIS BASE'S SIGNATURE DEFECT FOR THE NINTH TIME: p367 BUILT the
# second channel.  Its Makefile help text reads "the SECOND address channel, so a bare backticked
# slug is no longer invisible to every census at once."  🔴 p367 wired it into its OWN gate
# (gate-bare-slug-channel) and the CENSUS -- the thing that publishes the headline figure every
# pass quotes -- was never switched over.  Seven passes have published a denominator from one
# channel while the second sat green in `make hooks`.
